purpose: Resolve the selected adjacent absolute-return-persistence concept into one exact no-value mechanism and challenge it against terminal and prospective families before any Campaign028 source partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is opened.

selected_mechanism.name: intraday_absolute_return_serial_persistence_236p
selected_mechanism.formula: population PearsonCorr(abs(r_t), abs(r_t+1)) across the 118 adjacent return-magnitude pairs inside each 120-close trading half, pooled to 236 equal-weight pairs
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: A higher value means one-minute price-adjustment intensity persists into the next minute, consistent with clustered information assimilation or liquidity demand that may carry from the next open through the third close.
selected_mechanism.selected_bar_grid: exactly 240 one-minute closes at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 after frozen timestamp normalization; standalone 09:30 is excluded and no return or pair crosses lunch
selected_mechanism.return_rule: Form 119 adjacent natural-log close returns separately inside each 120-close half, then take the exact absolute value of every return.
selected_mechanism.pairing_rule: Within each half pair absolute-return positions 1 through 118 with positions 2 through 119. Pool the 118 morning and 118 afternoon pairs in chronological half order; use no pair across lunch.
selected_mechanism.correlation_rule: Use equal-pair-weight population Pearson correlation across all 236 lag and lead absolute-return pairs.
selected_mechanism.zero_rule: Retain every exact-zero return magnitude in every fixed lag or lead position; never remove, bridge, replace, or tolerance-reclassify zero returns.
selected_mechanism.variance_rule: Require strictly positive population variance in both complete 236-element lag and lead magnitude vectors.
selected_mechanism.bar_rule: All 240 selected closes must be finite and strictly positive before log returns are formed.
selected_mechanism.endpoint_rule: Only values within 1e-12 of -1 or +1 may be canonicalized to the exact endpoint; no statistical clipping is allowed.
selected_mechanism.missing_rule: Any invalid or nonpositive selected close, nonfinite return magnitude, nonpositive variance in either vector, nonfinite score, or score outside [-1,1] after endpoint canonicalization makes the stock-day missing.

overlap_challenges.reason: The diffusive-variation factor compares aggregate quadratic variation with adjacent absolute-return products and is a scale decomposition. Campaign028 separately centers the lag and lead magnitude vectors and measures their serial dependence; it is invariant to their separate additive levels after centering. Statistical proximity remains an explicit 0.8-gated comparison.

Entropy and skewness summarize order-invariant marginal concentration or signed third moments. Campaign028 is ordering-sensitive and uses adjacent absolute-return covariance without signed third moments or entropy bins.

Volatility resolution compares total morning and afternoon squared-return mass. Campaign028 pools both halves and measures only within-half one-step magnitude persistence, not the allocation of volatility across halves.

Those mechanisms retain direction signs and discard or subordinate magnitude. Campaign028 removes every sign before pairing and measures continuous magnitude dependence rather than sign agreement counts.

The amount-profile factor correlates adjacent log1p(CNY amount) levels. Campaign028 reads no amount or volume and correlates adjacent absolute close returns formed separately inside each trading half.

Range reversal uses high-low widths from neighboring OHLC bars and freezes a reversal orientation. Campaign028 reads close only, uses between-close return magnitudes, and freezes higher serial persistence.
Campaign024 correlates a signed open-close body with the next bar's high-low range. Campaign028 uses neither open/high/low nor direction and correlates adjacent absolute close returns.

Campaign027 correlates signed morning and afternoon returns at equal ordinal positions across lunch. Campaign028 never pairs the halves, removes signs, and measures only one-step magnitude persistence inside each half.

Candidate49 measures repeated close crossings of causal cumulative VWAP using close, volume, and amount. Campaign028 reads close only, contains no VWAP or crossing count, and remains historical-research-only.
Campaign028 contains one raw close-path statistic and no terminal factor value, transform, filter, model, or combination.
